Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Organizații non-profit
About the role 
 We are looking for an experienced ITC Manager to take ownership of our IT function, ensuring secure, reliable and efficient technology services across the organization. 
 This is a hands-on individual contributor role , combining IT strategy with technical delivery. You will work independently, coordinate external providers and collaborate with internal stakeholders and IT colleagues across our international federation.
 Key responsibilities 
Define and implement the IT strategy, annual plan, policies and budget.
Manage Microsoft 365 for approximately 300 users, Azure and AWS environments, and on-premises infrastructure.
Oversee cybersecurity, identity and access management, data protection and technology-related compliance.
Ensure reliable multi-site connectivity, system monitoring, backups and disaster recovery.
Manage IT suppliers, contracts, licenses and subscriptions, identifying opportunities to optimize costs.
Coordinate IT projects, upgrades and migrations, ensuring delivery within agreed timelines, budgets and security requirements.
Provide or coordinate technical support, resolve operational issues and maintain IT assets and documentation.
 Candidate profile 
Bachelor’s degree in IT, Computer Science, Computer Engineering or a related field.
Minimum 4–5 years of relevant experience in IT infrastructure, systems administration, cloud administration or IT operations.
Experience taking ownership of a broad IT environment, including budgeting, vendor management and technology projects.
Strong practical knowledge across several of the following: Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Intune, Azure, AWS, Windows Server, Active Directory, VMware/Hyper-V, networking, backup and recovery, and cybersecurity.
Strong troubleshooting, organizational and prioritization skills, with the ability to work independently.
Good English communication skills and the ability to explain technical topics clearly to non-technical colleagues.
Willingness to travel between the organization’s locations as required.
 Nice to have 
Relevant Microsoft, AWS, Cisco, VMware or cybersecurity certifications.
Experience working with geographically distributed organizations or teams.
 About SOS Children’s Villages Romania 
 We support children and families in vulnerable situations, providing family-based care and helping families stay together. Our mission is to help children grow up in a loving, safe environment and develop their full potential. 
 ﻿ In this role, your expertise will support the technology that enables our teams to deliver that mission.
